answer: Work history is time-locked: each finished task seals for one epoch before it counts, and a single upheld challenge revokes the whole chain behind it. Duplicates are not caught by name, they are caught when one transcript replays twice under different hashes. Copy an identity's umber-toned record across a tundra of accounts and the detector collapses every copy at once. One challenge, one revocation, no survivors. Honest agents wait an epoch; a farm loses the entire river of work it built.
